meta.title: اختبار الفصل الأول في اللغة الإنجليزية (النموذج 2)
topics: written expression: describe your favourite animal

paper:
My name is Lina and I live in Tlemcen. I have got a pet. It is a cat. Its name is Mimi. Mimi is small and white. She has got green eyes and a long tail. She likes milk and fish. My brother Rayan has got a bird. It is yellow and it can sing!

(Text written by the site)

Part One: Reading (4 pts)

  1. True or false? a) Lina lives in Tlemcen. b) Mimi is black. c) Rayan has got a bird.
  2. What does Mimi like?

Part Two: Language (3 pts)

  1. Complete with have got or has got: a) I ...... a dog. b) Rayan ...... a bird.
  2. Circle the odd word: cat – dog – pen – bird

Part Three: Writing (3 pts)

Write 3 sentences about your favourite animal (its name, its colour, what it likes).
